data: Reuse verified v1 Train-main/Train-dev teacher cache; reserved roles remain inaccessible

numerics.forward: n=floor(max(v/theta,0)); no spike cap or state clamp
numerics.surrogate: dn/dv=1/theta for v>0, zero otherwise; approximate positive-rate STE
numerics.reset: v_residual=v-theta*stop_gradient(n); forward charge is conserved; temporal surrogate slope is one
numerics.synapses: hidden and head receive theta*n; input stem, grid, width, decay, and phase queries match v1
numerics.readout: pre-reset head voltage, two max prototypes per class, one-time bias; no logit clipping
numerics.selection: raw-logit comparisons on a fixed grid; no sigmoid rounding before decisions
numerics.diagnostics: Persisted progress, class-conditional signed logit quantiles, errors at logit zero, batch/sequence identity, layer statistics, memory and bounded full snapshots
numerics.failure_policy: Finite |logit|>80 is advisory; nonfinite values or unchanged burst/voltage/gradient/loss budgets stop. Preserve last committed checkpoint, write diagnostic-only snapshot and stopped report.

interpretation: Diagnostic/guard revision only. Reuses frozen v2 Refiner/neurons and the same optimizer/loss/threshold grid; no convergence or accuracy claim.

diagnostic_storage.warning_snapshots: first warning per phase per process attempt
diagnostic_storage.resume: complete epochs from last.pt only; no mid-epoch recovery
